seal.statement: Every registered invariant cites a contract the impact-contract registry knows: each of the 26 citations the derived harness model reports as unbound either receives a registration in test/shards/impact-contracts.json with exactly one witness test, or a ruled-out finding retiring the citation from architecture/contracts/invariants.json, so that no invariant remains that nobody can witness and the harness model's unbound count reaches zero by derivation.

text: Inventory of the 26 unbound citations (derived from the probe on 94cfca8a0, not typed; contractIdOf = basename of contractRef minus .md; an invariant binds when the registry knows that id AND the contract has at least one src/ owner). Four groups. (A) 12 citations whose contractRef is a closure-ledger entry or an epic AND which already carry liveEvidence.evidence.test, an existing red-on-violation witness: CL-041/CL-042/CL-040 (test/closure/CL-04x.repro.test.js, owners src/raft/liferaft.js + in-memory-log-adapter.js), CL-038 (test/rebalancer/cl-038-source-removed-handoff-terminates.test.js, src/rebalancer/priority-publication-leader-safety.js), CL-035 (test/control-plane/cl-035-voter-ready-row-seed.test.js), CL-033 (cl-033-planning-projection-memo.test.js, src/control-plane/control-plane-readiness-publication-planning-snapshot.js), CL-034 (cl-034-planning-snapshot-merge-memo.test.js, ...planning-resolution.js), CL-001 (test/control-plane/active-node-projection.test.js, src/control-plane/active-node-projection.js), golden-capability-gold-plating (test/rebalancer/failed-authoritative-read-admission-verdict.test.js), publication-readiness-churn-liveness-closure x3 (publication-readiness-churn-liveness.test.js twice, control-plane-read-authority-token.test.js once - one contract id, three invariants: a contract id carries ONE witness under the constraint, so the two invariants sharing publication-readiness-churn-liveness.test.js bind through it and readiness-owner-read-non-amplifying needs its own contract id or a ruled-out finding). (B) 11 core-system-logic invariants (architecture_owner, Alloy model architecture/models/alloy/core-system-logic.als plus statechart; witnessed today only by test/scripts/model-contract-tools.test.js, which checks the model files exist and parse - not red on a violated invariant): one registration whose witness is the Alloy run if a test can be made to fail on a violated assertion, else ruled-out per invariant as architecture-level with no src/ owner (the binding rule needs one). (C) readiness-handoff-liveness x2 (startup_runtime_handoff_owner, TLA models/readiness-handoff/ReadinessHandoff.tla, no liveEvidence; owner under src/bootstrap/shared/startup-runtime-handoff-owner*): a red-on-violation witness to write, or a ruled-out finding. (D) rolling-restart-rebalancer-handoff x1 (bounded-owner-reentry, operation_workflow_owner, src/rebalancer/operation-workflow-owner-ports.js per the contract doc's ownerBoundaryMap): as C. Constraint check: retire-or-register-never-relabel forbids pointing an epic-cited invariant at an unrelated registered contract; registering the ledger/epic basename itself as the contract id is what the binding rule reads, so (A) registers those ids as they stand and re-points nothing. Decide per group in the first attempt.
